title: TAA transfers, descriptor image layouts, and rendering bracketing — detailed implementation
rationale: Remaining VUIDs map to three root causes: (1) copies from images missing TRANSFER_SRC (06662); (2) descriptor imageLayout vs actual layout conflicts (09600/00344), aggravated by using a storage image view that spans all mips while later mips are in SRV layouts; (3) draw calls placed outside dynamic rendering (renderpass VUID). This CR gives exact usage flags, barrier sequences (Synchronization2), view splits, and a rendering flow that eliminates the faults.

references.topic: draw must be in active render pass (dynamic rendering instance)

edits.action: Set explicit usage flags. For m_taaCurrentImage (HDR color target used as copy source), include VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT. For m_taaHistoryImage (copy destination + SRV), include VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT. Keep both in TILING_OPTIMAL.
notes: Current: m_taaCurrentImage lacked TRANSFER_SRC; m_taaHistoryImage already had TRANSFER_DST.

edits.action: Use Synchronization2 barriers outside any dynamic rendering instance. Exact sequence:
sequence: Barrier A: history SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL -> TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL (srcStage=FRAGMENT_SHADER, srcAccess=SHADER_READ; dstStage=TRANSFER, dstAccess=TRANSFER_WRITE)

Barrier B: current SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL (or COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL if just rendered) -> TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL (srcStage=FRAGMENT_SHADER or COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT, srcAccess=SHADER_READ or COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE; dstStage=TRANSFER, dstAccess=TRANSFER_READ)
Barrier C: history TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL -> SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL (srcStage=TRANSFER, srcAccess=TRANSFER_WRITE; dstStage=FRAGMENT_SHADER, dstAccess=SHADER_READ)
Barrier D: current TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL -> SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL (srcStage=TRANSFER, srcAccess=TRANSFER_READ; dstStage=FRAGMENT_SHADER, dstAccess=SHADER_READ)
notes: Ensure updateTAAHistory() is called when no dynamic rendering instance is active. If needed, end the rendering instance before calling this function.
Descriptors sampling these images must specify imageLayout=VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL.

edits.action: Split views: create a dedicated storage image view that covers mip 0 only (levelCount=1) for compute writes (GENERAL), and a separate sampled image view covering all mips for graphics sampling (SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL). Bind the storage-only view in the compute descriptor (binding = storage image).
notes: This prevents validator from expecting all mips to remain in GENERAL when the descriptor is bound as storage across the full chain.
Graphics path must bind the sampled image view; compute path binds the storage-only view.

edits.action: Ensure this function only binds pipeline and draws. Remove all transitions/copies; those must happen outside rendering in the caller.

instrumentation: On pipeline creation, log tag and pColorAttachmentFormats[0] — e.g., [PIPE] volume-SDR=B8G8R8A8_*, volume-HDR=R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT
Log BEGIN/END of dynamic rendering instances with target and format
Log descriptor imageInfos for TAA history/current once: {binding, layout}
acceptance: No VUID 06662 during TAA history update (copy) or when copy path is avoided entirely
No VUID 09600/00344 related to image layout mismatches (including mip-level complaints)
No 'vkCmdDraw must be issued inside active render pass' VUIDs across the frame
post_steps: Run with validation layers enabled; tee output to logs/run.txt
If copies still produce overhead, consider removing copy path entirely and doing shader-only TAA composition (drop TRANSFER_SRC usage then)
